text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—The time is February. Spring is near. A 
grand battle among festive souls 
begins...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone and their mother is plotting day 
and night to win over the one they fancy. 
I love that spirit!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The same goes for me. I cannot afford to 
be picky about my methods――!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"And that is why, Trainer! Happy 
Valentine's!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea what she meant by "So that's 
why"... but apparently, she's giving me 
chocolates. Her thoughtfulness makes me 
very happy!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Kahahah♪ Sorry about callin' ya out to a 
place like this.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I poured so much "love" into you that, as 
you can see, I can't carry it anymore.
choice_data_list: It's too heavy to ca—wait, what!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where No Reason pointed, a towering 
chocolate castle keep stood high above!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it, we're good friends, 
aren't we?! Eat up without any hesitation! 
Snap right in starting from the 
shachihoko♪
choice_data_list: Well then... time to dig in!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can taste the wasanbon sugar... It's so 
delicious. That said, I couldn't eat it 
all at once, so I decided to break up the 
rest and take it home.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm! Once the grand unveiling is done, we 
intend to have ye do so from the start.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Savor my "love" bit by bit, every single 
day♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, love! A beautiful word that even 
Naoe Kanetsugu bore on his helmet♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I froze at her utterly straightforward 
words. I'm happy. Incredibly happy, but...
choice_data_list: (Isn't that a bit of an exaggeration...?)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hm, what's the matter? You have quite a 
troubled look on your face. Did I lean a 
bit too much into my own tastes with the 
castle shape, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Not even swayed by this much, huh? A 
formidable one, indeed.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Then prepare the second and third arrows! 
We're heading out. Make ready!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhh! Like I'd let you!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well now, how did you like the amusement 
hall I recommended?! Sports chambara gets 
the blood pumping, doesn't it~?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
There, aim around that spot! Leave your 
back to me. Now's your chance to strike 
them down with your own hands!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Quietude is also quite nice... This castle 
ruins park happens to be one of my favored 
spots.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"I have long wished to bring thee here. 
Over yonder stands a delightfully crooked 
pine. It hath such wonderful character."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the broth is boiling now. I'll blanch 
the meat for ye. Eat up, eat up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"They really are strangely kind...! Or 
rather, am I being treated like royalty 
right now?!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—Yo! What do ya think? Aren't the city 
lights purty?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, art thou not cold? I have hand 
warmers with me! Care to use one?"
choice_data_list:
Um... aren't you being a bit too nice 
today?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Because it is Valentine's, after all! 'Tis 
the perfect opportunity to seize a firm 
hold of thy heart.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Thou...! After all that has been done, 
dost thou still not understand?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: That I would, to you...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
That she was trying her hardest to make me 
swoon!
choice_data_list: Huh? What do you mean by "drop"...?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, what a truly airheaded lord of the 
castle.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
You are full of openings. At this rate, 
those who scheme to curry favor with you 
will worm their way into your inner circle 
without end.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Strategist, the brilliance of your 
intellect was made abundantly clear during 
the Classics.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
However, the news of that must have spread 
far and wide by now. There's no telling if 
some scoundrel might try to tempt you away 
from me.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hence, such lavish hospitality! These 
persimmon-black sweets, rather than 
golden-yellow, are our bribe!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If you stay by my side, you can enjoy 
another wonderful Valentine's next year 
too, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was surprised... I had always thought 
that if I wasn't useful, I'd just be 
discarded.
choice_data_list: (Are you trying to... hold me back?)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well now? Having tasted such sweet 
success, you cannot resist, can you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I chuckle softly to myself. Even without 
chocolates or outings, I would never 
betray her to begin with, but...
choice_data_list: I'm definitely gonna get bucked off!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ...! Is that true...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: All right, looks like a success...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Phew~~~~! All right, good...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nnh, what the... nothing...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was it just my imagination, or did they 
look somewhat relieved...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
M-My word~! Even if I were betrayed, I 
would simply appoint a new tactician...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Though I may not look it, I am quite 
popular. You are not the only Trainer out 
there for me, you know!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chase, and they flee; cling, and they 
drift awayâsuch is human nature. The 
saying, "A samurai flaunts a toothpick 
even when starving," came to mind...
choice_data_list: I'm not going anywhere, so don't worry!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nwoh! Wh-What are you saying!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I am NOT worried, hmph!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason kept putting on airs all the way 
home. Saying something about how it's wise 
to follow her, as she would conquer the 
world one day...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm... Now that we've come this far, it 
might be best to just lay all our cards on 
the table.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I'm done with it. Putting on airs and 
trying to act bigger than I am, that is.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Tell me, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
âBetrayal and jumping ship are just part 
of life. I have no right to stop them.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
However, unraveling history reveals the 
truth. Interests may clash, but in the 
end, it is personal character that truly 
speaks.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I cannot betray the one I have resolved to 
conquer this path with.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In other words, "love" is the greatest 
benefit of all...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In short, it's about heart. It's about 
gratitude. Appealing to their genuine 
feelings is the best strategy.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Did you have fun with me 
today?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I see, then that is most splendid.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Having you betray me would be far too 
great a loss, you see...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Such ambition, to treat even the heart as 
a 'tactic'... Yet, I do not consider that 
underhanded.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She's counting on my strength... In that 
case, I will—!"
choice_data_list: I'll never, ever leave your side!
I'll never, ever leave your side!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hoh.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I see, I see...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: You really said it, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Heh......! You won't go back on your word, 
right?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I won't forget those passionate words just 
now!
choice_data_list: Um, excuse me, where is No Reason...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Whooo knows, really? How I act depends 
entirely on the situation!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Lament not.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Not wishing to be betrayed by my Trainer 
blindly is my true, unvarnished feeling.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Because you are my... well, for now, my 
one and only capable strategist!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I don't wanna give it to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether it was a tactic or her true 
feelings... Before I knew it, I had been 
pinned down by my own words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her true intentions remain shrouded in 
mystery. Even so, I didn't feel bad about 
it at all.
